> This is simply not true. The docs have stated for years that ASVS is for both security professionals and developers well before you joined the project and I ask you to stop asserting otherwise.

Did I say it is not for developers or I said "The goal of ASVS is not to educate developers"? To make it more precise - the main goal for ASVS is to provide security verification requirements, investigating ASVS is educative by nature and comes as a side-effect.

> I ask you to stop asserting otherwise

In return, I ask you to read _precisely_ that I have said and not apply sentences to me what I did not say. The recommendation is not limited to this issue.
